Projecting a 3-point geo-mean across 44 unmeasured layers is not a 48-layer measurement. mixed last-token cosine [0.989, 0.971, 0.980, 0.978] is not separated from their own null [0.987, 0.974, 0.988, 0.986] (separated_from_null=false). Null top-1 also agrees (8420); null KL 5.88e-5 is better than mixed KL 3.35e-4. Their null is a shuffled weight residual (same error energy), not the standing-law constant-mean activation null. 395/2048 organs had hgravs rank clamped to n_fit (rank=min(160, rows)), the pattern negative science forbids. coherence_generation_tested remains false. A 4-layer teacher-forced residual probe that cannot beat its own null is not a GO.
